selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main truth taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah is perfect, and He has no partners.

questions.question: What in the universe helps prove this idea?
questions.answer: Its wisdom, beauty, justice, and purpose.

questions.question: How was the universe brought into being?
questions.answer: Allah made it from nothing.

questions.question: What role does man have in showing the Creator’s signs?
questions.answer: Man shows them like a mirror.

questions.question: Why are human perfections important in the passage?
questions.answer: They show that people have a special place in creation.

questions.question: According to the passage, what would happen to all the perfect beings we see?
questions.answer: They would seem destroyed in meaning and worth.

questions.question: What would happen to the wise and beautiful beings we see if people believed in partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Their value and meaning would be ruined.

questions.question: How would animals and other living beings be affected in that false picture?
questions.answer: Their world would seem cruel.

questions.question: What would happen to thinking and feeling people in that false idea?
questions.answer: Life would seem very sad and heavy for them.

questions.question: What would happen to the Creator’s endless perfect qualities?
questions.answer: Their reflection would be hidden.

questions.question: Which truth is explained in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of perfections.

questions.question: What are some clues of perfection in the world around us?
questions.answer: Wise design, lovely beauty, fair rules, and good goals.

questions.question: What do just laws in the universe show?
questions.answer: They show that creation is made with fairness and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the running of the cosmos?
questions.answer: It is managed in a marvelous and beautiful way.

questions.question: Which creature is called the most important fruit of the universe?
questions.answer: Man.

questions.question: How is man honored in the passage?
questions.answer: Man is called very important, loved, and precious.

questions.question: Why does that false idea not fit with divine perfection?
questions.answer: It denies the Creator’s full greatness and perfect work.

questions.question: What feeling about the world would come from that false belief?
questions.answer: The world would seem sad, cruel, and without true purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage say all the wisdom and beauty in the universe do?
questions.answer: They give clear proof of real perfection.

questions.question: Which parts of creation especially show these signs?
questions.answer: Its wisdom, beauty, justice, and purpose show them.

questions.question: In what way do people give testimony?
questions.answer: Their special qualities show signs of the Creator’s perfection.

questions.question: What is one reason the passage gives for rejecting partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Partners would ruin the meaning of all perfection.

questions.question: What would be wrong about giving partners to Allah?
questions.answer: It would go against all these perfections.

questions.question: What false idea does the passage strongly reject?
questions.answer: The idea of making partners with Allah.
